subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be an opt-in queue mode or policy instead of changing the existing `steer` default?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the requested pause-or-abort, inject, and resume lifecycle is not implemented, but choosing that behavior affects session state, transcript/tool pairing, provider cancellation, channel delivery, and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving current boundary steering as the default.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Declare current steer a model-boundary feature and close or narrow this broad request after the active-run ingress tracker resolves.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing `steer` more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for workflows that depend on current boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving current boundary steering as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed this issue as a runtime/product lifecycle decision and have adjacent ownership history in the affected docs and runtime paths.
